verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents multiple public APIs (CKS cluster management API, Inference API) with clear auth via Bearer tokens, generated clients across many languages (Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, Swift), multiple transport protocols (Connect/gRPC/Protobuf), and Terraform/OpenTofu IaC for programmatic control. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of API usage and more comprehensive API reference coverage (e.g., full endpoint catalog) beyond docs snippets.
